{"consolidated_memory":"ANALYTICS FUNNEL MISSING STEP: SEVEN DISTINCT OCCASIONS (2026-02-05 to 2026-08-03)

File: analytics/dashboards/funnel.py (analytics side)
Symptom: Missing step in the funnel report—a stage with zero users between two populated ones
Reproduction: Build the funnel for the two-week window
Test file: tests/analytics/test_funnel.py

**OCCASION 1: [2026-02-05]**
Trigger: Payloads above roughly two megabytes
Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
PR #3723, branch fix/missing-step-2
Result: Throughput rose 86 percent to 791 requests per second

**OCCASION 2: [2026-02-08]**
Trigger: Two requests racing on the same key
Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query
PR #4679, branch fix/missing-step-3
Result: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 68 days running

**OCCASION 3: [2026-02-13]**
Trigger: After a rolling restart of the fleet
Root cause: Naive datetime compared against an aware one
Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
PR #5687, branch fix/missing-step-4
Result: Memory settled at 937 MB instead of climbing past 4 GB

**OCCASION 4: [2026-05-10]**
Trigger: Clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
Root cause: Clock skew between two hosts
Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
PR #6895, branch fix/missing-step-5
Result: Error rate dropped from 9.4 percent to under 5 per ten thousand

**OCCASION 5: [2026-06-01]**
Trigger: Accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
Root cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
Fix: Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
PR #6965, branch fix/missing-step-6
Result: Backlog cleared 29 minutes after the deploy
Note: Context carried over from earlier missing step work

**OCCASION 6: [2026-07-29]**
Trigger: Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Root cause: Schema drift between the migration and the model
Fix: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
PR #9168, branch fix/missing-step-7
Result: Flaky test went from 86 failures per hundred runs to zero

**OCCASION 7: [2026-08-03]**
Trigger: Input list came in empty
Root cause: Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
Fix: Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
PR #9583, branch fix/missing-step-8
Result: Job finished in 17 minutes instead of 3 hours

Stack: Python throughout all occasions"}
